topic: Requesting Two Weeks of Vacation in Advance

script.title: TWO WEEKS IN OCTOBER
script.scene_zh: 倉庫辦公室 · 排休申請
script.story_hook: He wants October, and the calendar wants it too.
script.intro_zh: 他想休十月，可日曆上的安排也擠在十月。
script.welcome_en: Hi, welcome to a delivery company office. Listen for vacation request phrases.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎來到物流公司的辦公室。留意請假的實用說法。
script.outro: And October is safely booked for Ethan. Listen again and repeat out loud.
script.outro_zh: 十月的假期就這麼穩穩排定了。再聽一次，大聲跟著說。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.char_a_description: a stocky man in his late thirties with a shaved head and a thick black beard, a neon orange safety vest over a grey hoodie, steel-toe boots, and strong forearms
script.char_b_description: a composed woman in her forties with dark brown hair in a tight low bun, round black-frame glasses, a navy blazer over a white blouse, a slim wristwatch, and an average build with straight posture

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got a minute? I'd like to ask about time off.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ə ˈmɪnɪt aɪd laɪk tə æsk əˈbaʊt taɪm ɔf/
dialogue.zh: 有空嗎，老闆？我想請個假。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, Ethan, sit. It's not bad news, I hope.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ ˈiθən sɪt ɪts nɑt bæd nuz aɪ hoʊp/
dialogue.zh: 好啊，伊森，坐。希望不是壞消息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good news, actually. I want to book two weeks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd nuz ˈæktʃuəli aɪ wɑnt tə bʊk tu wikz/
dialogue.zh: 其實是好消息，我想連休兩週。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two whole weeks... um, when were you thinking?
dialogue.phonetic: /tu hoʊl wikz ʌm wɛn wɚ ju θɪŋkɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 整整兩週……嗯，你打算什麼時候？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First half of October, flying to visit family.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɝst hæf əv ɑkˈtoʊbɚ flaɪŋ tə ˈvɪzɪt ˈfæməli/
dialogue.zh: 十月上半，我要飛回去看家人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ah, your folks out east, long time no see?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑ jɔɹ foʊks aʊt ist lɔŋ taɪm noʊ si/
dialogue.zh: 啊，你東部的家人，很久沒見了吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four years, and the little one started walking.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔɹ jɪɹz ænd ðə ˈlɪɾəl wʌn ˈstɑɹɾɪd ˈwɔkɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 四年了，家裡最小的都會走路了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's a reason right there, go on with it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ə ˈrizən ɹaɪt ðɛɹ ɡoʊ ɑn wɪð ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 光這個理由就夠了，繼續說吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, the dates, October fifth through the nineteenth.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə ˈdeɪts ɑkˈtoʊbɚ fɪf θɹu ðə naɪnˈtid/
dialogue.zh: 日期是十月五日一直到十九日。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: October... well, let me check the board first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑkˈtoʊbɚ wɛl lɛt mi tʃɛk ðə bɔɹd fɝst/
dialogue.zh: 十月……嗯，讓我先看看排班板。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please do, I checked it online, looks quiet.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz du aɪ tʃɛkt ɪt ˈɑnˌlaɪn lʊks ˈkwaɪət/
dialogue.zh: 請看，我先在線上查過，看起來很空。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, you did your homework, that earns some points.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ju dɪd jɔɹ ˈhoʊmˌwɜɹk ðæts ɜɹnz sʌm pɔɪnts/
dialogue.zh: 哈，你功課都做在前面了，這能加分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Some? So there's a catch, I can feel it.
dialogue.phonetic: /sʌm soʊ ðɛɹz ə kætʃ aɪ kən fil ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 只是「有些」？那一定有條件，我有感覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not a catch, more a calendar hiccup, see here.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ə kætʃ mɔɹ ə ˈkælənˌdɛɹ ˈhɪkˌʌp si hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 不是困難，只是日曆有點塞車，你看這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The inventory count, that's the second week, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈɪnvənˌtɔɹi kaʊnt ðæts ðə ˈsɛkənd wik ɹaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 庫存盤點，剛好壓在第二週，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It does, two whole days where nobody can vanish.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt dʌz tu hoʊl deɪz wɛɹ ˈnoʊˌbʌdi kæn ˈvænɪʃ/
dialogue.zh: 對，那整整兩天，誰都不能消失。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Vanish is strong, I just need to book the flight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈvænɪʃ ɪz stɹɔŋ aɪ dʒʌst nid tə bʊk ðə flaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 消失說重了，我只是要把機票訂到手。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fair, and um, October is a green light anyway.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛɹ ænd ʌm ɑkˈtoʊbɚ ɪz ə ɡɹin laɪt ˈɛniˌweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 也對，況且十月本來就是綠燈，放心安排。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Really? So can I slide to October first then?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɹɪli soʊ kæn aɪ slaɪd tə ɑkˈtoʊbɚ fɝst ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？那我可以往前挪到十月一日出發嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that clears my fishing week too, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðæt klɛrz maɪ ˈfɪʃɪŋ wik tu hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 可以，這樣也剛好避開我的釣魚週，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your fishing week? The cooler in your trunk?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔɹ ˈfɪʃɪŋ wik ði ˈkulɚ ɪn jɔɹ trʌŋk/
dialogue.zh: 您的釣魚週？後車廂那個保冷箱？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Guilty, two weeks a year, we all take turns.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɡɪɾti tu wikz ə jɪɹ wi ɔl teɪk tɜɹnz/
dialogue.zh: 瞞不住了，我一年兩週，大家輪流休。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, October first it is, thank you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt ɑkˈtoʊbɚ fɝst ɪt ɪz θæŋk ju/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，就十月一日，謝謝您。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Works for me, see? Bosses book fun too.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɜɹks fɔɹ mi si ˈbɑsəz bʊk fʌn tu/
dialogue.zh: 我這邊沒問題，你看，老闆也得安排快樂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now, who covers my route while I'm gone?
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ hu ˈkʌvɚz maɪ ɹut waɪl aɪm ɡɔn/
dialogue.zh: 那，我不在的時候，誰來顧我的路線？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's your part of the job, find a willing hand.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts jɔɹ pɑɹt əv ðə dʒɑb faɪnd ə ˈwɪɾɪŋ hænd/
dialogue.zh: 這就要你自己出力了，找一位自願接手的人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Marcus mentioned wanting extra hours, he'd love it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɑɹkəs mɛnˈʃənd ˈwɑntɪŋ ˈɛkstrə ˈaʊɚz hid lʌv ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 馬可斯提過想多接工時，他應該樂意。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Marcus is solid, talk to him by Thursday.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɑɹkəs ɪz ˈsɑləd tɔk tə hɪm baɪ ˈθɜɹzˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 馬可斯很可靠，週四前先跟他談好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll ask him now, he's loading the van outside.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl æsk hɪm naʊ hɪz ˈloʊdɪŋ ðə væn aʊtˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 我現在就去問他，他正在外面裝貨車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: While you're at it, check the portal rules.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪl jʊɹz æt ɪt tʃɛk ðə ˈpoɾəl ɹulz/
dialogue.zh: 順路的話，也確認一下線上申請的規矩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The portal? Um, I filled it once, last spring.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈpoɾəl ʌm aɪ fɪld ɪt wʌns læst spɹɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 線上系統？呃，我去年春天填過一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same steps, pick dates, name your cover, submit.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm stɛps pɪk deɪts neɪm jɔɹ ˈkʌvɚ səbˈmɪt/
dialogue.zh: 步驟一樣，選日期、寫代班人、送出。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to attach the flight details there?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid tə əˈtætʃ ðə flaɪt dɪˈteɪlz ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 我要在系統上附機票資訊嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, flights are private, we only need the dates.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ flaɪts ɑɹ ˈpɹaɪvət wi ˈoʊnli nid ðə deɪts/
dialogue.zh: 不用，機票是私人資訊，我們只要日期。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, that's one less form to print, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ðæts wʌn lɛs fɔɹm tə prɪnt hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 好，那就少印一張表，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now, the golden rule for the two weeks off.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə ˈɡoʊldən ɹul fɔɹ ðə tu wikz ɔf/
dialogue.zh: 現在說說這兩週休假的黃金準則。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me guess, don't check any work email.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi ɡɛs doʊnt tʃɛk ˈɛni wɜɹk ˈimeɪl/
dialogue.zh: 我猜是：假期裡別碰工作的郵件。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You learned it already, the phone is not a pet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju lɜɹnd ɪt ɔlˈɛɾdi ðə foʊn ɪz nɑt ə pɛt/
dialogue.zh: 你已經懂了，手機不是寵物，別一直餵它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, my sister texted me all of last vacation.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ maɪ ˈsɪstɚ tɛkst mi ɔl əv læst veˈkeɪʃən/
dialogue.zh: 哈，上個假期，我姊的訊息傳個沒完。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Family first, work can wait, that's the deal.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfæməli fɝst wɜɹk kən weɪt ðæts ðə dil/
dialogue.zh: 家人擺第一，工作等得了，這就是約定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I set an auto-reply on my account?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ sɛt ən ˈɔɾoʊ rɪˈplaɪ ɑn maɪ əˈkaʊnt/
dialogue.zh: 我可以在帳號裡設自動回覆嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, keep it short: back in October, contact Marcus.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs kip ɪt ʃɔɹt bæk ɪn ɑkˈtoʊbɚ kɑnˈtækt ˈmɑɹkəs/
dialogue.zh: 可以，寫簡短些：十月回來，請找馬可斯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Back in October, contact Marcus, I'll type it tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæk ɪn ɑkˈtoʊbɚ kɑnˈtækt ˈmɑɹkəs aɪl taɪp ɪt təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 「十月回來、請找馬可斯」，我今晚就打進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect. Oh, one tiny thing about the pay date.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt oʊ wʌn ˈtaɪni θɪŋ əˈbaʊt ðə peɪ deɪt/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。噢，還有發薪日的一件小事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The tenth falls right inside my trip, hmm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tɛnθ fɔɹz ɹaɪt ɪnˈsaɪd maɪ trɪp ʌm/
dialogue.zh: 十號剛好落在我的旅途中，嗯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Direct deposit doesn't need you present, relax.
dialogue.phonetic: /dəˈɹɛkt dɪˈpɑzɪt dʌzənt nid ju ˈpɛzənt ɹɪˈlæks/
dialogue.zh: 自動轉帳不需要你人在場，放心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank goodness, my mom worries about that stuff.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ˈɡʊdnəs maɪ mɑm ˈwɜɹiz əˈbaʊt ðæt stʌf/
dialogue.zh: 謝天謝地，我媽最操心這類事情。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mothers everywhere share one worry list, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmʌðɚz ˈɛvɹiˌwɛɹ ʃɛɹ wʌn ˈwɜɹi lɪst hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 全天下的媽媽都共用同一張擔心清單，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, anything else before I bother Marcus?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ˈɛniθɪŋ ɛls bɪˈfɔɹ aɪ ˈbɑðɚ ˈmɑɹkəs/
dialogue.zh: 那，在我去打擾馬可斯之前，還有別的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just the request form, and print yourself a copy.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ðə ɹɪˈkwɛst fɔɹm ænd prɪnt jɔɹˈsɛlf ə ˈkɑpi/
dialogue.zh: 只剩申請單，另外自己影印一份。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Copy, pen, and my best friendly voice for Marcus.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɑpi pɛn ænd maɪ bɛst ˈfrɛndli vɔɪs fɔɹ ˈmɑɹkəs/
dialogue.zh: 影印、筆，還得用最友善的嗓音面對馬可斯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, he'll say yes faster if you bring donuts.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ hil seɪ jɛs ˈfæstɚ ɪf ju brɪŋ ˈdoʊnəts/
dialogue.zh: 哈，你帶甜甜圈去，他會點頭更快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Noted, apple or glazed? That's a real question.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊɾəd ˈæpəl ɔɹ ɡleɪzd ðæts ə ɹiəl ˈkwɛstʃən/
dialogue.zh: 記下了，蘋果口味還是糖漿的？這可是大問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Glazed, always glazed, that's my only strong rule.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡleɪzd ˈɔlˌweɪz ɡleɪzd ðæts maɪ ˈoʊnli stɹɔŋ ɹul/
dialogue.zh: 糖霜派，永遠的糖霜派，這是唯一讓我固執的規矩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, two weeks with family, I can almost see it.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl tu wikz wɪð ˈfæməli aɪ kən ˈɔlˌmoʊs si ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，跟家人團聚的兩週，我幾乎已經看見了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You earned the flight, go, we'll keep things steady.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɜɹnd ðə flaɪt ɡoʊ wil kip θɪŋz ˈstɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 這趟飛機是你掙來的，去吧，這邊我們會顧好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you, boss, truly, this means the world to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju bɔs ˈtɹuli ðɪs minz ðə wɜɹld tə mi/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你，老闆，說真的，這對我意義重大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go plan your donut peace with Marcus right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊ plæn jɔɹ ˈdoʊnət pis wɪð ˈmɑɹkəs ɹaɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 現在就去找馬可斯，用甜甜圈談成和平吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One form tonight, one flight, one happy October. Bye.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn fɔɹm təˈnaɪt wʌn flaɪt wʌn ˈhæpi ɑkˈtoʊbɚ baɪ/
dialogue.zh: 今晚填表、一趟航班、一個開心的十月。再見。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bye Ethan, bring back a photo of the little one.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ˈiθən brɪŋ bæk ə ˈfoʊtoʊ əv ðə ˈlɪɾəl wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 再見伊森，記得挑一張家裡小寶貝的照片讓我看。

script.youtube_title: 【連休兩週怎麼請🗓️】「十月就是綠燈」跟老闆談假期全對話🎧｜忙碌時段・代班人選・自動回覆💬✈️｜聽完就敢開口｜Vacation Request
script.youtube_title_en: "October Is a Green Light" — Asking My Boss for Two Weeks Off
script.youtube_description:
「十月就是綠燈」——想連休兩週回鄉看家人，該怎麼跟老闆開口才不心虛？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在物流公司的辦公室。

你會聽到：開口請假的前奏、避開庫存盤點週、把出發日往前挪、請同事自願代班、線上系統怎麼送件、休假中不回郵件的黃金準則，還有發薪日自動轉帳的安心說法。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與短句，夾著美國人真實口語的小語感：um、well、oh、ha、anyway。聽完你就會用：I'd like to ask about time off、Can I slide to October first?、Who covers my route?、Back in October。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱與開通小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"October is a green light" — you want two whole weeks off to see family, and you have to ask your boss in English. This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice set in a small delivery company office.

You will hear: opening the vacation talk, dodging the inventory count week, sliding the dates earlier, lining up a coworker to cover your route, the request portal steps, the no-email rule, and payday worries.

Everything stays in A2-level words with the small sounds Americans really use: um, well, oh, ha. By the end you'll own phrases like I'd like to ask about time off, Who covers my route?, and Back in October, contact Marcus.

The back half is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

四年沒見的家人，連最小的都會走路了，這段回家的路，你會用英文請下兩週假嗎？盤點週和釣魚週撞在一起，該怎麼辦？
